description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a pivotal leadership role where you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in shaping the resident experience and fostering a supportive environment for our nursing staff. This full-time opportunity offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and dedication to quality healthcare.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Thorough knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $85,000 - $95,000 per year, based on experience.
